pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 WORD CLASS: ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we compare things, people or events?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify comparative and superlative forms of adjectives in a text
2. order adjectives in terms of size, shape and age appropriately
3. use the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives accurately

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify comparative and superlative forms of adjectives in a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify comparative and superlative forms of adjectives in a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. order adjectives in terms of size, shape and age appropriately
   In simple words: practise until you can order adjectives in terms of size, shape and age appropriately. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. use the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives accurately
   In simple words: practise until you can use the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives accurately. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives.
4. Show that you can: identify comparative and superlative forms of adjectives in a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Describe items using the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives e.g. that window is bigger than this one,
2. Fill gaps using adjectives in the correct order,
3. Creativity and Imagination is enhanced as the learner creates crossword puzzles and make sentences based on adjectives.
4. Environmental Education is enhanced as the learner is exposed to information on traditional foods.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we compare things, people or events?
2. Which words are used to describe things or people?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify comparative and superlative forms of adjectives in a text
2. order adjectives in terms of size, shape and age appropriately
3. use the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives accurately

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
